Arkasha, they never bargain in Moscow.
I will quickly win all this money back.
The sum really seems enormous.
I decided to make you governor of the region.
Are you really speaking completely seriously?
You are a young and very promising leader.
I will not give the region to strangers.
Load all the bags into the trunk quickly.
Viktor Stepanovich, huge thanks for your trust.
That's it, relax, now you are under protection.
I will never let you down.

the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: put items onto a vehicle or into bags

examples.trans: We are carefully loading all the money.
The workers were loading bags into the truck.
The governor has come to the town.

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.
How are we going to build our defence?
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me
как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: They are considering you for the post of minister.
The new minister held the first meeting.

examples.text: Молодой человек, как на тест-драйв записаться?
examples.trans: Young man, how do I sign up for a test drive?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.
We lifted the barbell, we'll raise the region!
The whole region knows his name.

examples.text: Я быстро отобью все эти деньги.
examples.trans: I will quickly win all this money back.

examples.text: Инвестор надеется отбить вложенные средства за год.
examples.trans: The investor hopes to recoup the invested funds within a year.

meanings.en: to give away, to hand over

examples.trans: He will hand over the money.
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Ты молодой и очень перспективный руководитель.
examples.trans: You are a young and very promising leader.

The cat is under the table.
I will never let you down.

examples.text: Надёжный друг никогда не подведёт в беде.
examples.trans: A reliable friend will never let you down in trouble.

meanings.note: пост мэра = the office of mayor

examples.text: Он идёт на пост мэра города.
examples.trans: He is running for the post of mayor of the city.

meanings.en: to bargain, haggle for a bit

examples.trans: Maybe it is worth bargaining a little?
The buyer decided to bargain a little at the market.
She is the new head of the headquarters.

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.
This is a completely new car.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for
сколько стоит? = how much is it?

examples.text: Давайте я вам помогу с сумкой.

examples.trans: It is customary to bargain merrily at an oriental bazaar.
